svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two UPN 160 channels 840 mm long, webs 104 mm apart (inside faces),

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flanges pointing out. Weld a 10 x 104 x 139 mm block between the webs

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at each end, flush with the ends. The gap takes the uprights plus shims.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Joint holes, 18 mm, through both webs: at 272, 328 (right) and -272, -328

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: (left) mm from the middle; 50 and 110 mm up from the beam bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the two channels clamped together so the holes line up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stud holes, 14 mm, in the bottom flanges: 335 and 385 mm each side of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the middle, 88 mm each side of the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spring lugs: 30 x 150 x 8 mm flat bar across the top flanges, 190 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each side of the middle, 12 mm hole in the centre; weld both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jack plate: 240 x 234 x 20 mm, four 14 mm holes at 105 and 90 mm from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its middle; bolted across the top flanges with 4 x M12 (matching holes).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld three 10 x 40 x 15 mm blocks round the jack base, 82 mm out, at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 90 degrees; leave the right front open for the release valve.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: webs parallel within 1 mm; the uprights slide in with shims.
